questions.q: The new scheduling software will ______ us save a lot of time. 空格填什麼？
questions.exp: 助動詞 will 後面接原形動詞 help，不加 -s、to 或 -ing。

questions.q: You ______ wear a tie to the office; our dress code is casual. 空格填什麼？
questions.exp: 服裝規定是便服，表示「不必」打領帶：don't have to。mustn't 是「禁止」，意思變成不准打領帶。

questions.q: Passengers ______ leave their bags unattended in the terminal. 空格填什麼？
questions.exp: 公告講不准做的事，用 must not（禁止）；don't have to 和 needn't 是「不必」。

questions.q: Yesterday, the IT team ______ fix the bug after six hours of work. 空格填什麼？
questions.exp: 過去某一次做成功了，肯定句用 was able to，不用 could；yesterday 是過去，所以不是 can 或 is able to。

questions.q: That ______ be the right price. It's ten times higher than last year's. 空格填什麼？
questions.exp: 價格高得離譜，很確定「不是」正確價格：can't be。推測時 must 的否定是 can't，mustn't 是禁止。

questions.q: We ______ ordered more paper. Now the printer is empty and the supply store is closed. 空格填什麼？
questions.exp: 本來應該訂、但沒訂，現在後悔：should have＋過去分詞。must have 是推測「一定訂了」，跟紙用完的處境對不上；needn't have 是「不必做卻做了」。

questions.q: Would you mind ______ me the file before the meeting? 空格填什麼？
questions.exp: Would you mind 後面接 -ing，不接 to＋原形。

questions.q: You'd better ______ the client before the price changes. 空格填什麼？
questions.exp: had better（'d better）後面接原形，不加 to。

questions.q: When I joined the company, I never imagined I ______ become a director. 空格填什麼？
questions.exp: 站在過去（剛進公司時）看未來，用 would；整句是過去，不用 will 或 can。

questions.q: The lights in the lab are still on at midnight. Someone ______ be working late. 空格填什麼？
questions.exp: 半夜燈還開著，很確定有人在加班：must be。
